en: A multi‑view sports‑event postcard. The top photo shows a stadium crowd with many national flags on flagpoles. The middle photo shows large groups of people in colored outfits arranged on a running track and field. The bottom photo is a night scene of the same stadium, with participants holding lights or candles forming illuminated patterns on the field. In the center there is a logo with two interlocking rings and text, and at the bottom there is printed event information including the year 1987.
